guardrails: Unknown or unavailable evidence never counts as zero, absent, passing, supported, or qualified.
Recommendation and execution do not download models, code, or datasets; acquisition is a separate approved operation with source, license, and SHA-256 checks.
Images, prompts, filenames, host identifiers, raw event telemetry, private messages, and user datasets are not exported as roadmap or qualification evidence.
Candidate discovery cannot promote or replace a bundle; promotion, revocation, and rollback require separate reviewed records.
Research candidates, model-card metrics, imports, and smoke runs cannot establish a public support or performance claim.
A missing exact environment, workload, protocol, artifact, license, or quality match results in hold, blocked, or abstained rather than an inferred fallback.
out_of_scope: RTSP in the first stream lane

phases.deliverable: Typed interface contracts, privacy-safe environment profiling, evidence records, deterministic abstaining selection, read-only recommendation, and pinned local execution for bounded images.
phases.title: Build deterministic adaptive-routing foundation

phases.deliverable: Honest baseline registration, governed screening of initial open-vocabulary and low-latency families, optional adapters only after approval, and real-host qualification when hardware is available.
phases.title: Onboard and qualify initial algorithm bundles

phases.deliverable: Monitored-source discovery, fail-closed screening, isolated acquisition and execution, evidence freshness monitoring, reviewed promotion, terminal revocation, rollback, and failure drills.
phases.title: Automate evidence-gated algorithm intake and rollback

phases.deliverable: Preregistered workload and SLO profiles, three consented on-prem workflows, and an exact measured-scope support decision without cross-environment extrapolation.
phases.title: Prove adaptive routing in real on-prem workflows

phases.deliverable: Separate bounded local-stream, session-tracking, and static-image OCR interface contracts, qualification records, routing extensions, and Experimental implementations.
phases.title: Add bounded streaming, tracking, and OCR lanes

product_boundary.current_stable_lane: prediction validation and evaluation through the predictions interface contract
product_boundary.execution_boundary: Local and offline after explicitly approved assets are present; no implicit download or runner-requested network access.
product_boundary.natural_language_boundary: The AI client compiles free-form instructions into a typed request; the YOLOZU core does not embed an LLM.
product_boundary.recommendation_boundary: Highest-ranked only among candidates with matching qualification evidence and all stated constraints; otherwise abstain.
